Dinner with friends
Dec 2025 • Family
The food was overall a real experience and surprised me positively. The quality of the individual courses was particularly impressive: everything was very finely tuned, lovingly arranged and excellent in taste. You immediately notice that high-quality ingredients are used here and a lot of emphasis is placed on details. Each plate not only looked beautiful, but also tasted exactly as good as it looked.

The starters were light, elegant and perfectly balanced. The aromas were harmonious, not overloaded, and yet exciting. The main courses were also convincing: intense in taste, very well seasoned and prepared to the point. I particularly liked the creative combination of classic elements and modern accents – that makes the food special and will be remembered.

The desserts were also a real highlight. Fine, not too sweet, visually very appealing and with great textures. You could really enjoy and end the evening culinary. All in all, it felt like cooking here was really passionate.

The only small minus was the pizza, which unfortunately could not convince. It was much weaker compared to the rest of the food and did not quite fit the otherwise very high level of cuisine. That was a shame, but it hardly matters given the many positive impressions.

Overall, the food was excellent, high quality and very enjoyable. Except for the pizza, everything was really very good and absolutely recommended – a culinary experience that you like to repeat.

Evening
Dec 2025 • Friends
🍝 Cosa Nostra 🍷

We were eating at Cosa Nostra and overall it was a very nice visit. Most dishes were very good in taste, lovingly arranged and of high quality. You can see that a lot of emphasis is placed on details and the kitchen works with creativity. Especially the starters and desserts surprised us positively – finely tuned, fresh and visually a treat.

The service was friendly and the ambience pleasant, so you immediately feel comfortable and can enjoy the food in peace. Overall, we had a round and beautiful dining experience.

Unfortunately, there was a small minus: The pizza didn't convince us. In terms of taste and consistency, it didn't meet our expectations, which was a shame as the rest of the food was really good.

Nevertheless, the positive impressions clearly prevail, and Cosa Nostra is definitely worth a visit – only with the pizza there is still room for improvement.

Zero service, poor quality kitchen
Jan 2025 • Family
The restaurant was striking in the worst sense of the word. Expected a completely different one. We took the order. It wasn't until 20 minutes later that the wine card arrived. Then they started bringing food, and two dishes per person at the same time. At the same time, the child was brought last, although the simplest pasta was ordered. And only then did the drinks come! But not water, water was asked for several times! Two of them had stone bacon or just rock in their carbonara paste, we didn't establish exactly, but the dish was replaced. 
The wait is colossally long.
The restaurant is not worth a visit at all, refrain! Or get the last nerve cells ready.
